integrity_notes: Exact finite formulas follow from disjoint arc-variable families; exhaustive small-size checks are supplementary to the proofs. Published marginal domination estimates and generic two-round game methods are acknowledged as prior tools.
scientific_limitations: Only a fixed-cardinality sparse unary marking of a uniform fair tournament is studied.
A complete quantifier-rank-two probability spectrum is proved only for the dyadic subsequence with limiting parameter one.
The rank-three conclusion concerns a specific first interaction formula and the joint cross-orientation count, not a complete rank-three classification.
The literature inspection does not establish absolute historical priority; independent validation is absent.
title: Poisson cross-orientations and the first rank-three probability gap in sparsely marked tournaments
